data.title: 泽塔 · 鸟居旁挂起第一只风铃
data.description: 祭典尚未开场，鸟居旁的摊架只挂好半串灯。泽塔抬手把一只玻璃风铃系到横梁，长尾从印着金色豹纹的黑法披后轻轻摆过去。她退半步，听铃舌在第一阵晚风里响了一声。
data.location: 鸟居旁临时搭起的祭典摊架
data.action: 踮脚抬手给横梁系上玻璃风铃
data.lighting: 夕光透过薄玻璃风铃，暖色纸灯照到法披的金边
data.promptProse: Before the festival opens, Zeta ties a glass wind chime to a stall beam beside the shrine gate. Her short black happi has golden leopard-print borders over a white tunic, dark shorts and tabi with wooden geta. She steps back just as the breeze makes the chime ring once.
data.animaCaption: Her hand steadies the glass while she tightens the knot above it, with the first lit lantern at her shoulder.
